entry.title: v3.7.14
entry.content:
Important: Please read the migration guide.

CVE fixed:

  • Advisory GHSA-53qr-784g-cj35
  • Advisory GHSA-cw35-4q88-3rmp
  • Advisory GHSA-fh26-gfpp-7xxx
  • Advisory GHSA-mwrr-6hp4-pxr6
  • Advisory GHSA-qm9f-w54v-q2qh
  • Advisory GHSA-qvj7-gq9c-hp7q
  • Advisory GHSA-rv2h-qh7j-xrjw
  • Advisory GHSA-mhjw-hmjv-p99x

Bug fixes:

  • [acme] Bump github.com/go-acme/lego/v5 to v5.5.1 (#13929 @ldez)
  • [acme] Bump github.com/go-acme/lego/v5 to v5.5.2 (#13952 @ldez)
  • [acme] Close the newly created ACME storage file on Windows (#13860 @datrixlab)
  • [docker] Bump github.com/docker/cli to v29.8.1 (#13934 @kevinpollet)
  • [fastproxy] Isolate NTLM and Negotiate backend connections in FastProxy (#13914 @kevinpollet)
  • [k8s/gatewayapi] Allow configuring gateways (#13819 @kevinpollet)
  • [k8s/gatewayapi] Bump sigs.k8s.io/gateway-api to v1.6.2 (#13984 @kevinpollet)
  • [k8s/gatewayapi] Do not create the Gateway API routers a previous one shadows (#13946 @rtribotte)
  • [k8s/gatewayapi] Do not let TLSRoute routers shadow TCPRoute routers (#13953 @rtribotte)
  • [k8s/gatewayapi] Fix HTTP/GRPC routes conflict (#13421 @AnatoleLucet)
  • [k8s/gatewayapi] Fix TLSRoute router name collision across listeners sharing an entry point (#13959 @rtribotte)
  • [k8s/gatewayapi] Report the BackendTLSPolicy ancestor in the namespace of its Gateway (#13964 @rtribotte)
  • [k8s/gatewayapi] Stable sort Gateways to keep the TLS certificate order stable (#13911 @rl-io)
  • [k8s/ingress-nginx] Build the ssl-passthrough HTTP route like any other ingress (#13915 @rtribotte)
  • [k8s/ingress-nginx] Do not normalize resource names in the ingress-nginx provider (#13922 @kevinpollet)
  • [k8s/ingress-nginx] Fix the ingress-nginx cross-links between the routing and provider docs (#13925 @simpleqt)
  • [k8s/ingress-nginx] Make trailing capture group optional in ImplementationSpecific paths (#13455 @mmatur)
  • [k8s/ingress-nginx] Remove Authorization header for basic and digest auth (#13631 @josmo)
  • [k8s/ingress-nginx] Set the Ssl-Client-* request headers on the Ingress-NGINX HTTP router (#13912 @rtribotte)
  • [k8s/ingress-nginx] Support wildcard origins in cors-allow-origin for the ingress-nginx provider (#13726 @kimsehyoung)
  • [logs, middleware, k8s/crd] Expose IngressRoute metadata in access logs (#12985 @mmatur)
  • [middleware] Avoid deprecated table.maxn in the rate limiter Lua script (#13825 @lazerg)
  • [otel] Bump go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlpmetric to v1.46.0 (#13933 @kevinpollet)
  • [otel] Bump go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace to v1.46.0 (#13932 @kevinpollet)
  • [otel] Bump otlploggrpc and otlploghttp to v0.22.0 (#13931 @kevinpollet)
  • [rules] Ignore negated matchers when parsing rule domains (#13863 @rtribotte)
  • [server] Bump golang.org/x/crypto to v0.57.0 (#13930 @kevinpollet)
  • [server] Silence encoded characters warning when some are disallowed (#13470 @Adel-Ayoub)
  • [service] Dedicate a sticky transport per ServersTransport (#13838 @sdelicata)
  • [service] Fix the second server selection bias in the P2C load balancer (#13644 @lazerg)
  • [service] Isolate preauthenticated NTLM and Kerberos backend connections (#13902 @kevinpollet)
  • [udp] Copy UDP datagrams into right-sized buffers before queuing (#13941 @rtribotte)
  • [webui] Bump react-router to v7 and vite to v8 (#13794 @gndz07)
  • Fix build with GOPROXY=direct (#12724 @mehrdadbn9)

Documentation:

  • [accesslogs] Clarify access log buffering behavior (#13510 @amazon7737)
  • [accesslogs] Clarify that USR1 only reopens the access log file (#13955 @rtribotte)
  • [k8s] Clarify nativeLB load balancing behavior in Kubernetes reference docs (#13358 @zarko-a)
  • [security] Document the coordinated disclosure embargo for security reports (#13982 @emilevauge)
  • [server] Fix misleading trailer comments in header strategy handlers (#13938 @AleksaMCode)
  • [tcp] Fix 'allows to configure' grammar in TCP ServersTransport (#13894 @fng713)
  • Fix 'allow to match' grammar in TCP HostSNI rules (#13895 @fng713)
  • Fix case-sensitive option anchors (#13924 @simpleqt)
  • Fix the end anchor in the single-test example (#13898 @amazon7737)

entry.content:

Bug fixes:

  • [acme] Bump github.com/go-acme/lego/v5 to v5.4.1 (#13759 @ldez)
  • [acme] Disable recursive nss propagation by default for DNS challenge (#13830 @rtribotte)
  • [acme] Do not require recursive nameservers propagation by default for the DNS-01 challenge (#13710 @amazon7737)
  • [acme, tls] Ignore negated matchers when parsing rule domains (#13725 @rtribotte)
  • [consulcatalog, nomad] Build a collision-free item key in the Consul Catalog and Nomad providers (#13741 @rtribotte)
  • [http3] Dedicate a transport per HTTP/3 client connection (#13812 @sdelicata)
  • [k8s/ingress-nginx] Fix sticky cookie expiration per request (#13496 @makaiver)
  • [k8s/ingress-nginx] Create HTTP redirect router for ssl-passthrough with force-ssl-redirect (#13457 @mmatur)
  • [k8s/ingress-nginx] Preserve leading dot in sticky session cookie Domain attribute (#13456 @mmatur)
  • [logs, middleware] Set access log entry level and time before formatting the OTLP body (#13767 @emilevauge)
  • [logs, tls, k8s/crd] Downgrade default TLS resources namespace mismatch log to warning (#13780 @lazerg)
  • [middleware] Fix {url} placeholder in customErrors middleware now includes correct scheme (#13320 @AnouarMohamed)
  • [middleware, authentication] Prevent user enumeration through the basic auth singleflight key (#13816 @sdelicata)
  • [server] Build the configuration copy once per change (#13746 @jspdown)
  • [server] Do not forward h2c upgrade headers to the backend (#13797 @sdelicata)
  • [server] Deny request with an opaque request target (#13796 @sdelicata)
  • [server] Do not forward request trailer values to the backend (#13822 @rtribotte)
  • [server] Bump github.com/quic-go/quic-go to v0.62.0 (#13807 @Nelwhix)
  • [tls] Redact duplicate TLS certificates in provider merge logs (#13548 @xsergos)
  • [webui] Fix displayed number on details pages (#13779 @gndz07)

Documentation:

  • [k8s] Add warning about Ingress API frozen state (#13783 @jnoordsij)
  • [k8s] Remove namespace reference for providers.kubernetesGateway.labelSelector (#13790 @jnoordsij)
  • [k8s/crd] Fix broken redirect for the Kubernetes CRD reference docs (#13811 @thev1ndu)
  • Tell scanning agents to read the security policy and decisions pages (#13753 @emilevauge)
